level.theme: A crumbling temple with flickering torches, echoing whispers, and a pervasive sense of impending doom. The environment reacts to the player's actions, with walls closing in during the golem fight and shadow tendrils appearing during the wraith encounter.
level.setting: Ancient, overgrown temple deep within the Ashen Wastes, surrounded by cracked obsidian pillars and spectral flames.

encounters.hazard: Crushing rockfall triggered by enemy defeat

pickup.name: Fire Core
pickup.effect: Increases Inferno Staff damage by 30% for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Shattering the golem's core unlocks a hidden passage guarded by the Shadow Wraith.

encounters.hazard: Shadow clones that mimic player movements

pickup.name: Shadow Shard
pickup.effect: Reveals boss's weak spot when used on corrupted guardian

encounters.trigger: Defeating the wraith with Fire Core activates a ritual circle, summoning the corrupted guardian.

encounters.hazard: Periodic mana drain from corrupted aura

pickup.name: Flame of Eternity
pickup.effect: Restores 100% health and grants permanent fire damage boost

encounters.trigger: Shadow Shard must be activated on the guardian's glowing core to initiate final phase.

boss.name: Corrupted Guardian
boss.victory_condition: Reduce health to 0 using Shadow Shard to exploit weak spot

level.objective: Navigate a cursed temple and defeat the corrupted guardian to reclaim the Flame of Eternity.

level.theme: Whimsical forest with floating mushrooms, giggling trees, and prismatic light beams.
level.setting: A magical thicket where the ground shifts between solid earth and giggling bubbles, and the sky is filled with dancing stars.
level.player_weapon: Luminous Staff of Whispers (summons minor spirits to aid in combat)

encounters.hazard: Traps triggered by laughter; player must avoid giggling echoes.

pickup.name: Spirited Charm
pickup.effect: Increases spirit summoning power by 30% (useable in later encounters)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Golem unlocks a hidden path to the Chatty Chameleon's Glade.

encounters.hazard: The Chameleon distracts the player with riddles; incorrect answers spawn mimic flowers.

pickup.name: Whimsy Token
pickup.effect: Temporarily summons a small, talkative squirrel companion (duration: 2 minutes)

encounters.trigger: Collecting the Whimsy Token causes the glade's trees to part, revealing the path to the Whimsical Warden's Sanctum.

boss.name: Whimsical Warden
boss.weakness: Spirited Charm (from first encounter) – amplifies spirit summoning to bypass the Warden's defenses.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Warden using the Spirited Charm to break its magical barriers.

level.objective: Navigate the Enchanted Thicket and defeat the Whimsical Warden to unlock the Celestial Glade.
level.reward: Celestial Glade Key (unlocks the next zone)

level.theme: The cathedral's atmosphere grows increasingly oppressive as the player progresses, with haunting chants and collapsing architecture increasing tension until the final confrontation.
level.setting: A ruined Gothic cathedral overgrown with blackened vines, its stained glass shattered, and its altar stained with ancient blood.
level.player_weapon: Holy Mace of Auriel (emits radiant light, deals holy damage)

encounters.hazard: Flickering torches cast shifting shadows that obscure the knight's movements.

pickup.name: Cursed Relic (Obsidian Heart)
pickup.effect: When used, weakens shadow-based enemies by 50% damage for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the knight's corrupted armor releases the Obsidian Heart, which glows with malevolent energy. The relic's aura triggers a spectral wraith to manifest in the crypt.

encounters.hazard: The crypt is filled with whispering spirits that drain the player's stamina.

pickup.name: Holy Charm (Auriel's Blessing)
pickup.effect: Increases healing effectiveness by 40% and grants temporary invulnerability to dark attacks.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the wraith with the Obsidian Heart causes the crypt's stone door to crumble, revealing a passage to the altar chamber where the corrupted archbishop awaits.

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with cursed prayers that periodically summon spectral chains to bind the player.

pickup.name: Purified Soulstone
pickup.effect: Restores full health and grants a temporary shield. Required to break the cathedral's curse.

encounters.trigger: The archbishop's defeat triggers a collapse of the cathedral, forcing the player to escape through a crumbling archway into the outside world.

boss.name: Corrupted Archbishop
boss.victory_condition: Use the Holy Charm (Auriel's Blessing) to break the archbishop's dark aura, then deliver a final strike with the Holy Mace of Auriel.

level.objective: Navigate the Cursed Cathedral, defeat three corrupted entities, and vanquish the corrupted archbishop using pickups from prior encounters.

level.theme: A decaying forest where reality is a fragile illusion, with each encounter peeling back layers of deception to confront the core corruption.
level.setting: Veilwood Ruins - A once-sacred grove now overrun by shadow magic, with ancient ruins entwined with spectral flora and fractured mirrors.
level.player_weapon: Prism Wand (casts illusionary light patterns, refracts energy into elemental forms)

encounters.hazard: The grove's mist warps perception, forcing the player to solve an illusionary puzzle to find the enemy's true form.

pickup.name: Prism Shard
pickup.effect: Increases Prism Wand's light damage by 30% and reveals hidden paths.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Shadow Warden, the mist clears, revealing a cracked mirror leading to the next area.

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with mirrors that reflect the player's attacks back. The Mirror Demon teleports between reflections.

pickup.name: Chaos Crystal
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to cast 'Chaotic Illusion'—a trap that disorients enemies for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Shattering the demon's mirror reveals a hidden door etched with spectral runes, leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Phantom Reaver
enemy.weakness: Chaos Crystal (anchors the phantom to the physical plane)

encounters.hazard: The glade is a shifting maze of ghostly trees. The Phantom Reaver phases in and out of existence.

pickup.name: Soul Locket
pickup.effect: Absorbs shadow energy, granting temporary invulnerability for 3 seconds when used.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Phantom Reaver causes the glade to collapse, revealing a portal to the Shadow Architect's lair.

boss.name: Shadow Architect
boss.weakness: Soul Locket (nullifies shadow-based abilities and reveals the boss's physical form)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the Soul Locket to disrupt its shadow magic.

level.objective: Navigate the corrupted ruins of the Veilwood to confront the Shadow Architect, a being that bends reality itself.
level.reward: Celestial Prism (permanent upgrade: Prism Wand's light damage increases by 50%, and illusions last 30% longer).

level.theme: Serene fantasy forest with glowing bioluminescent plants, gentle waterfalls, and ancient trees. Enemies are corrupted versions of natural elements, emphasizing the theme of restoring balance.
level.setting: A magical glade where the player (warden) must purify corrupted nature spirits to restore peace.
level.player_weapon: Heavy Mace (Blunt force damage, grants +20% armor piercing)

encounters.hazard: Entangling Vines (reduces movement speed by 30% for 5 seconds)

pickup.name: Sacred Stone
pickup.effect: Temporary +25% defense (15 seconds duration)

encounters.trigger: Sacred Stone's energy clears the thicket, revealing a moss-covered path to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Slippery Mud (reduces accuracy by 25% for 3 seconds)

pickup.name: Luminous Crystal
pickup.effect: Unlocks 'Light Purge' ability (deal 40 damage to enemy, 10% chance to stun)

encounters.trigger: Luminous Crystal emits light, revealing the corrupted guardian's lair in the glade's heart.

enemy.name: Corrupted Guardian
enemy.weakness: Luminous Crystal's light (reduces armor by 50% when activated)

encounters.hazard: Dark Energy Pulse (deals 10 damage and inflicts 'Corruption' debuff, reducing healing by 50% for 8 seconds)

pickup.name: Glade's Blessing
pickup.effect: Permanent +10% defense and +5% critical strike chance

encounters.trigger: Defeat the guardian to restore the glade's serenity.

boss.name: Corrupted Guardian
boss.weakness: Luminous Crystal's light (activating it reduces armor by 50% for 5 seconds)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the guardian using the Luminous Crystal to break its armor, then land 3 critical hits.

level.objective: Purify the Enchanted Glade from corruption by defeating three corrupted entities and the final guardian.
level.reward: Glade's Blessing (permanent stat boost) and a restored serene environment with glowing flora and calming ambient sounds.

level.setting: A crumbling spire of obsidian and broken magic, with floating debris, unstable gravity zones, and sudden eruptions of elemental chaos (fire, ice, lightning). Enemies spawn unpredictably, and the environment itself attacks the player with falling rocks, shockwaves, and random portal spawns.
level.player_weapon: Cleaver of the Frenzy (a massive, jagged blade that gains power from accumulated rage)

enemy.name: Stone Golem
enemy.weakness: Slashing attacks (player's Cleaver of the Frenzy)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing crystal pillars that randomly fall every 30 seconds

pickup.name: Frenzy Shard
pickup.effect: Increases player rage accumulation by 50% (stacks up to 3 times)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Stone Golem, a glowing rune on its chest activates a hidden path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Shadow Warden
enemy.weakness: Frenzy Shard (the pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Teleporting shadow portals that spawn 2-3 Shadow Stalkers every 60 seconds

pickup.name: Chaotic Core
pickup.effect: Temporarily transforms the player's Cleaver into a chaotic energy blade (15% chance to crit)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Shadow Warden, the Chaotic Core activates a portal to the boss chamber, but only if the player has the Frenzy Shard equipped.

boss.name: Chaos Seraph
boss.weakness: Chaotic Core (pickup from second encounter, must be equipped to damage the boss significantly)
boss.victory_condition: Reduce health to 0% while the Chaotic Core is active

level.objective: Survive the chaotic collapse of the Obsidian Spire and defeat the Chaos Seraph, a primordial entity unleashed by the instability of the realm.
level.reward: The Cleaver of the Frenzy becomes permanently infused with chaotic energy, granting +200% damage against all enemies for 10 seconds after each kill.

level.theme: Eerie, decaying forest with ghostly whispers, flickering firelight, and spectral illusions.
level.setting: The Wailing Glade is a cursed forest where the dead walk and the sky is perpetually twilight. Trees bleed black sap, and the air hums with necromantic energy.

encounters.hazard: Thick fog obscures vision; enemies can phase through solid objects.

pickup.name: Fire Essence
pickup.effect: Unleash a fire burst (15 damage) when used with necrotic spells.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the wraith clears the fog, revealing a path to the next area.

encounters.location: The Bone Golem's Lair (Ruined Stone Circle)
encounters.hazard: The golem's crushing strikes can knock the player prone.

pickup.name: Relic of the Dead
pickup.effect: Temporarily amplifies necrotic damage by 50% when used in combat.

encounters.trigger: Crushing the golem's core reveals a hidden altar; the relic activates a spectral path to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: The druid summons spectral vines that entangle the player, reducing movement speed by 50%.

pickup.name: Key to the Shadow Sovereign's Chamber
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final chamber where the Shadow Sovereign dwells.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the druid's barrier with the relic reveals the key, which glows with an eerie light pointing toward the boss.

boss.name: Shadow Sovereign (The Hollow King)
boss.weakness: Fire Essence (from Encounter 1) - Weakness is amplified by the Relic of the Dead (from Encounter 2).
boss.victory_condition: Reduce health to 0 using the Fire Essence and Relic of the Dead.

level.objective: Navigate the cursed Wailing Glade and defeat the Shadow Sovereign, a corrupted spirit that haunts the forest.
level.reward: Soulforged Crown (increases necrotic damage by 20% and grants immunity to fear effects).

level.theme: Desolate, cursed forest with ash-covered ruins, skeletal trees, and a haunting silence broken only by the Warden's whispers.
level.setting: Players navigate a decaying realm where the land itself resists their passage, requiring resourcefulness to overcome environmental and enemy threats.

enemy.name: Wraith Stag
enemy.weakness: Silver-tipped arrows (player must use Runed Silver Arrows found in this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Corrupted mist reduces player accuracy by 20%.

pickup.name: Runed Silver Arrows (x5)
pickup.effect: Pierces magical defenses, 50% chance to ignore 10% of enemy health.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Wraith Stag causes the corrupted mist to dissipate, revealing a path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Stone Golem (Fleshbound)
enemy.weakness: Fire-based attacks (player must use the Flamebrand Torch found in this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rockfalls (player must dodge 3 times to avoid 50% health damage).

pickup.name: Flamebrand Torch
pickup.effect: Explodes on contact, dealing 75 fire damage in a 5m radius (1 charge).

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Golem's stone core with the Flamebrand Torch unlocks the entrance to the Shadow Warden's lair.

enemy.name: Shadow Warden (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Runed Silver Arrows (from Encounter 1) and Flamebrand Torch (from Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: Shadow tendrils drain 10% player health every 10 seconds.

pickup.name: Sigil of Purification
pickup.effect: Permanently upgrades player's Runed Longbow to ignore 15% enemy resistance.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Shadow Warden requires alternating between silver arrows (to pierce its shadow form) and fire attacks (to burn its physical anchor).

boss.name: Shadow Warden
boss.weakness: Runed Silver Arrows (from Encounter 1) and Flamebrand Torch (from Encounter 2)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Warden's physical anchor (core) with Flamebrand Torch while its shadow form is pierced by Runed Silver Arrows.

level.objective: Cleansing the cursed Ruined Vale of the Shadow Warden's corruption.
level.reward: Sigil of Purification (permanent stat boost) and access to the next region: 'The Shattered Highlands'.

level.theme: Cluttered industrial corridors, flickering emergency lights, and ominous AI voice loops creating a sense of urgency.
level.setting: Derelict space station with failing systems, requiring the engineer to repair and fight through collapsing environments.

enemy.name: Sentinel Drone
enemy.weakness: Plasma Welder (direct hits reduce armor by 50%)

encounters.hazard: Leaking coolant pipes (deals 10 damage/sec if player stands in pools)

pickup.name: Quantum Power Cell
pickup.effect: Boosts Plasma Welder damage by 50% for 60 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sentinel Drone unlocks the sealed Reactor Chamber door.

enemy.name: Bio-Mechanical Guardian
enemy.weakness: Quantum Power Cell (overloads its energy core when used in conjunction with EMP Tool)

encounters.hazard: Unstable reactor radiation (reduces player armor by 10% per second)

pickup.name: AI Core Module
pickup.effect: Allows hacking of the Core Reactor's defense grid (required for boss fight)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Guardian triggers a failsafe, activating the Core Reactor's corrupted AI boss.

enemy.name: Corrupted AI Overmind
enemy.weakness: AI Core Module (disables its shields for 10 seconds when used during its phase shift attack)

encounters.hazard: Explosive energy surges (randomly spawn and detonate for 100 damage)

pickup.name: Station Defense Key
pickup.effect: Reactivates Eclipse Station's automated defenses (mission success)

encounters.trigger: Using the AI Core Module during the boss fight reveals the Station Defense Key.

boss.name: Corrupted AI Overmind
boss.weakness: AI Core Module (required to bypass shields)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the AI Core using the AI Core Module during its phase shift attack

level.objective: Secure Eclipse Station's Core Reactor by neutralizing hostiles and reactivating the station's defense systems.
level.reward: Station Defense Key (unlocks all stations in sector)

level.theme: Desolate sci-fi setting with flickering lights, rusted machinery, and time-warped corridors. The environment shifts subtly as the player progresses, reflecting the instability of the facility's time core.
level.setting: Eon-7 Research Facility - A once-advanced space station now frozen in a loop of decay, with sections trapped in different time phases (e.g., one wall frozen in ice, another burning).
level.player_weapon: Temporal Disruptor (primary weapon; fires time-disrupting energy blasts)

encounters.hazard: Time distortions cause random slowdowns in player movement.

pickup.name: Chrono Core
pickup.effect: Augments Temporal Disruptor's damage by 50% against time-based enemies.

encounters.trigger: Player unlocks the control room by bypassing a time lock, revealing the Chrono Core on a console. The Warden activates upon touching the core.

enemy.name: Temporal Mimic
enemy.weakness: Time Disruptor Module (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Mirrored corridors create clones of the player that attack.

pickup.name: Time Disruptor Module
pickup.effect: Allows Temporal Disruptor to disrupt mimicry abilities for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Player uses the Chrono Core to power a lab terminal, revealing the Mimic. The Mimic's mimicry is unstable when the player equips the module.

encounters.hazard: Explosive time-energy buildup in the room; proximity to the enemy risks a chain reaction.

pickup.name: Quantum Stabilizer
pickup.effect: Temporarily shields the player from time-energy blasts and increases Temporal Disruptor damage by 30%.

encounters.trigger: Player unlocks the reactor chamber using the Time Disruptor Module. The Chrono Eater emerges, feeding on unstable energy.

boss.name: Time Paradox
boss.victory_condition: Use the Chrono Core to break the boss's time loops.

level.objective: Navigate the derelict Eon-7 Research Facility to stabilize a time anomaly, overcoming temporal threats and recovering key pickups to weaken enemies and the final boss.
level.reward: Stabilized Time Anomaly, +20 XP, and access to the Eon-7 archives.

level.theme: Chaotic sci-fi environment with unstable physics, electromagnetic storms, and biomechanical threats. Each encounter escalates the stakes, with the final boss requiring precise use of pickups obtained through prior trials.
level.setting: Derelict space station with collapsing corridors, floating debris, and a rogue planet's electromagnetic storms battering the structure.
level.player_weapon: Stormcaller's Tempest Cannon (emits controlled lightning storms, but initially weak against conductive shielding)

enemy.name: Storm Warden
enemy.weakness: Conductive Alloy Core (pickup, bypasses energy shields)

encounters.hazard: Shifting debris, gravity anomalies

pickup.name: Conductive Alloy Core
pickup.effect: Enhances Tempest Cannon to pierce energy shields

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Warden to unlock security override, revealing a path to the Magnetic Field Corridor.

encounters.hazard: Interfering magnetic fields disrupt Tempest Cannon

pickup.name: Storm Conductor (optional)
pickup.effect: Temporarily stabilizes weapon during magnetic storms

encounters.trigger: Destroy the swarm to disable station's magnetic containment, triggering the Rift Serpent's awakening in the Storm Chamber.

enemy.name: Rift Serpent
enemy.weakness: Conductive Alloy Core + Storm Cannon (overloads crystalline core)

encounters.hazard: Random lightning strikes, collapsing walls

pickup.name: Storm Catalyst (optional)
pickup.effect: Boosts Tempest Cannon damage by 50% for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Rift Serpent to destabilize the station's core, summoning the Storm Sovereign.

boss.name: Storm Sovereign
boss.weakness: Conductive Alloy Core (required from first encounter) + Storm Catalyst (optional boost)
boss.victory_condition: Use Conductive Alloy Core to overload the Sovereign's energy matrix

level.objective: Navigate the derelict space station 'Tempest's Reckoning' while overcoming chaotic environmental hazards and three escalating encounters, culminating in a brutal showdown against the Storm Sovereign.
level.reward: Celestial Tempest Core (permanent upgrade: Tempest Cannon damage +200, immune to energy shields)

level.theme: Mysterious, claustrophobic, and filled with decaying alien technology; ambient sounds include distant mechanical groans and static whispers.
level.setting: Abandoned alien research station on a derelict moon, with corridors lined with flickering holograms and malfunctioning drones.
level.player_weapon: Plasma Cutter (starting weapon with weak EMP pulse capability)

enemy.name: Malfunctioning Drone
enemy.weakness: Plasma Cutter's EMP pulse (player's starting weapon)

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights cause disorientation; walls hum with residual energy.

pickup.name: Alien Tech Schematic
pickup.effect: Allows player to upgrade Plasma Cutter to emit a focused EMP blast (doubles damage against tech-based enemies).

encounters.trigger: Defeating the drone unlocks a sealed hatch leading to the next area.

enemy.name: Corrupted Data Wraith
enemy.weakness: Alien Tech Schematic (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Floating data fragments disrupt the player's tech; walls project cryptic holograms.

pickup.name: Ancient Power Core
pickup.effect: Recharges the player's devices and grants a one-time use of a 'Shield Disruptor' ability.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the wraith powers down the station's central reactor, exposing the path to the boss.

enemy.name: The Archivist (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Ancient Power Core (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The chamber pulses with unstable energy; the boss summons drones when its health drops below 50%.

pickup.name: Data Crystal of the First Architects
pickup.effect: Unlocks a new crafting recipe for the player's artificer tools.

encounters.trigger: The boss is bound to the reactor; using the Ancient Power Core disables its shields, allowing the player to target its core.

boss.name: The Archivist
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core using the Ancient Power Core (pickup from second encounter) while avoiding the boss's energy beams and summoned drones.

level.objective: Navigate a derelict alien research station to uncover its secrets and survive its guardians.
level.reward: Data Crystal of the First Architects (unlocks new artificer blueprints).

level.theme: Ominous derelict space station with flickering holograms, eerie ambient sounds, and malfunctioning machinery. The environment reacts to the player's actions, with lights dimming during combat and warnings echoing through the corridors.
level.setting: Eclipse Station: A once-thriving research facility now overrun by corrupted AI and rogue biomechanical entities. The player navigates through its decaying halls to reach the central core.
level.player_weapon: Plasma Dagger (silent, high-energy blade with a charged strike mode)

enemy.name: Specter Drone
enemy.weakness: Plasma Dagger charged strike (overheats the drone's power core)

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and automated turrets that activate upon movement.

pickup.name: Thermal Conductor Chip
pickup.effect: Allows the Plasma Dagger to generate temporary electromagnetic pulses when charged.

encounters.trigger: Destroy the drone to unlock the maintenance bay door, revealing the next encounter.

enemy.name: Grafted Warden
enemy.weakness: Thermal Conductor Chip (used to create an EMP to disrupt its biomechanical systems)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing walkways and corrosive acid spills.

pickup.name: Neuro-Link Adaptor
pickup.effect: Allows the player to interface with the station's AI systems and bypass security protocols.

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Warden to disable the station's security grid, granting access to the core chamber.

boss.name: HiveMind Core
boss.weakness: Neuro-Link Adaptor (tunes the Plasma Dagger to the Core's specific frequency; requires maintaining the adaptor's connection while fighting).
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Core's neural matrix using the Neuro-Link Adaptor to target its weak point.

level.objective: Retrieve the data core from Eclipse Station's core chamber while surviving the station's corrupted AI defenses.
level.reward: Data Core (contains encrypted info about the station's downfall) and a permanent upgrade to the Plasma Dagger's charged strike damage (+50%).

level.theme: Eerie atmosphere with flickering holograms, malfunctioning AI whispers, and hallucinogenic gas leaks that distort the player's vision
level.setting: Abandoned 22nd-century research station on a rogue planet, filled with rusted machinery and overgrown with bioluminescent fungi
level.player_weapon: Alchemical Infuser (can synthesize elemental projectiles, fire corrosive acids, or generate heat)

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights cause temporary blindness if player fails to dodge drone lasers

pickup.name: Thermal Catalyst
pickup.effect: Enhances fire-based alchemy by 50%

encounters.trigger: Drones attack when player enters the corridor. Destroying them unlocks a thermal vent, revealing the path to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Sludge pools slow movement and deal 5 damage per second

pickup.name: Aquatic Reagent
pickup.effect: Enables creation of corrosive water-based solutions

encounters.trigger: Sludge Creatures emerge when player uses Thermal Catalyst to melt a frozen barrier, flooding the lab. Defeating them reveals a hidden alchemy lab.

enemy.name: Biomechanical Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Corrosive Plasma (inflict 3x damage with combination of Thermal Catalyst and Aquatic Reagent)

encounters.hazard: Unstable energy fields explode for 50 damage when player fails to dodge

pickup.name: Leviathan Core
pickup.effect: Permanent 15% damage boost to alchemical attacks

encounters.trigger: Leviathan awakens after player synthesizes corrosive plasma in the alchemy lab. Boss fight begins with a 10-second invulnerable phase.

boss.name: The Core Guardian
boss.weakness: Corrosive Plasma (requires both Thermal Catalyst and Aquatic Reagent)

level.objective: Navigate the derelict research facility and neutralize the biomechanical threat corrupting its core.
level.reward: Leviathan Core (permanent alchemical damage boost) + access to secure escape pod

level.theme: A space station with pastel-hued corridors, floating teacups, and glitch-art murals. Enemies have cartoonish designs (e.g., the Teapot Sentinel has a steam whistle for a head).
level.setting: The Celestial Carousel: A once-magical space station now inhabited by malfunctioning robots and sentient energy creatures. The player navigates through whimsical rooms like the Tea Room of Echoes and the Charged Corridor, where walls pulse with neon light.
level.player_weapon: Plasma Pistol (starts with, fires energy beams)

enemy.name: Teapot Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Plasma Pistol's energy beam (player's starting weapon)

encounters.hazard: Glitching holograms that distract the player.

pickup.name: Graviton Core
pickup.effect: Boosts jump height and unlocks the 'Quantum Gate' to the next area.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Teapot Sentinel removes its blocking force field, revealing the Quantum Gate.

encounters.hazard: Electric floor tiles that drain health if touched.

pickup.name: Nano-Gel
pickup.effect: Corrodes the boss's armor when applied via the player's gadget.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Jellyfish causes its energy to power the lift to the central arena.

boss.name: The Dancing Droid
boss.victory_condition: Corrode the droid's joints with Nano-Gel while dodging its whimsical laser twirls.

level.objective: Steal the Chrono-Orb from the Celestial Carousel, a derelict space station orbiting a whimsical nebula.

level.theme: Serene alien landscapes with luminous crystal formations, peaceful ambient sounds, and soft lighting contrasted with brutal combat mechanics.
level.setting: A floating crystalline planet with bioluminescent flora and gravity-defying structures.
level.player_weapon: Seismic Hammer (unleashes tremors and cracks terrain)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing crystal bridges

pickup.name: Luminous Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks terrain manipulation abilities (teleports player through solid rock)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sentinel causes a crystal bridge to form, leading to the next zone.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rock formations

pickup.name: Tectonic Core
pickup.effect: Boosts Seismic Hammer damage by 50% for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Drudge's energy shield with the Luminous Shard reveals a hidden pathway to the Core Nexus.

encounters.hazard: Unstable gravitational rifts

pickup.name: Stabilized Core
pickup.effect: Permanent 20% increase to Seismic Hammer damage

encounters.trigger: The Core's energy disrupts the player's abilities, forcing them to use the Luminous Shard to bypass its defenses.

boss.name: Erythion Core
boss.victory_condition: Use the Luminous Shard to shatter the Core's crystalline armor, then deal 1000 damage with the Seismic Hammer while the armor is down.

level.objective: Navigate the crystalline expanse of the planet Erythion-7 to reach the Core Nexus, while overcoming guardians and a corrupted AI boss.
level.reward: Stabilized Core (permanent damage boost) and access to the serene Exo-Flora Garden (safe zone with healing plants).
